log.message: Apply percentage coupons to the cart total
log.author: Ada

log.message: Fix rounding when a coupon and a gift card are combined
log.author: Bob

ai.text:
# Release 1.4.0

## New

- Percentage coupons are applied to the cart total.
- Free shipping from 50 EUR.

## Fixed

- Totals no longer drift by one cent when a coupon and a gift card are combined.
